summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq Transfer Confirmation Letter, confirming its transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market effective May 15, 2026. This follows a May 6 Hearing Panel decision granting continued listing exceptions for the Bid Price and Equity Rules, subject to interim milestones. No financial terms, recommendations, or advisors were mentioned. The filing is a routine compliance update regarding exchange listing status, not a special situation transaction.
